title: Member Handbook Extract: Expedited Prior Authorization Review Terms
content:
**Faster decisions on a Prior Authorization request.** In every Prior Authorization class of Prairie Ridge Health Plan, the member may ask for expedited review. A provider's certification that the standard timeframe could seriously jeopardize the member's health makes expedited review mandatory. When the plan refuses a member's expedite request, the request continues as a standard review, and written notice of the refusal follows the oral notice within 2 calendar days. An expedited decision is also given orally.

| Class | Member may ask for expedited review | Provider certification makes expedited review mandatory | A refused expedite request continues as a standard review | Written notice after an expedite refusal (calendar days) | Channels the member may use | Expedited decision also given orally |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Home Health Services Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 | phone, member portal | Yes |

**In plain terms.** The member can ask by phone or through the member portal, in any class. If the plan says no to the member's request for a faster decision, the member is told at once by voice, the letter follows within 2 calendar days, and the request keeps moving on the standard track.
